head: codex/5868-failure-detection
title: feat(runtime): add authenticated bounded failure detection
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5868

Implements authenticated, deterministic, advisory-only distributed failure detection in the two issue-owned paths. Distinguishes suspect, unavailable, partitioned, recovered, and flapping states without granting authority; binds probes and event identities to enrolled identity generation, membership epoch, and trust domain; and keeps replay, subject, observer, and event state hard bounded.

Validation:
- cargo nextest run --manifest-path adl-runtime/Cargo.toml --test distributed_failure_detection --no-tests=fail (14/14)
- cargo clippy --manifest-path adl-runtime/Cargo.toml --test distributed_failure_detection -- -D warnings
- exact v3 receipt validator PASS
- independent exact-head review PASS with no findings

Module registration remains deferred to #5878 by design.
